categories.main_business_segments: Zhongrong Printing Group Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the manufacturing industry focusing on paper-based printing and packaging products. Its main product lines include folding cartons, gift boxes, promotional display tools, e-commerce packaging boxes, and paper bags. The company provides comprehensive printing and packaging solutions including R&D, design, production, and sales services for various industries such as cosmetics, oral care, personal and household care, food, health products, pharmaceuticals, consumer electronics, tobacco, and alcohol.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced printing and packaging technologies including intelligent manufacturing, digital printing, color management, network printing, and green environmentally friendly packaging materials and production technologies. It has developed three main production platforms tailored for small batch digital printing, high-quality flat printing with finishing processes, and large-scale flexographic integrated production. The company emphasizes innovation in micro-engraving technology, flexible cushioning packaging, lightweight recyclable gift boxes, high barrier degradable paper-based packaging, and pulp molding to replace plastic packaging.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Zhongrong serves leading domestic and international brands primarily in fast-moving consumer goods and consumer electronics sectors. Key customer industries include cosmetics, oral care, personal and household care, food, health supplements, pharmaceuticals, consumer electronics, tobacco products, and alcoholic beverages. The company has established strong partnerships with top-tier clients and provides customized packaging solutions to meet diverse market needs.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates multiple production bases across China covering South China (Zhongshan), North China (Tianjin), East China (Kunshan, Pinghu, Shanghai), Northeast China (Shenyang), Central China (Wuhan), Southwest China (Chengdu, Guizhou), and has expanded overseas with a production base in Vietnam. This multi-regional layout enables rapid response to cross-regional customer procurement demands and supports just-in-time delivery.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhongrong operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain as a manufacturer and service provider of printed packaging products. It integrates upstream R&D and design with downstream production, quality control, and supply chain management, offering end-to-end packaging solutions to brand owners and retailers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on becoming a global leading printing and packaging solutions provider by emphasizing market and R&D dual drives, digital and intelligent manufacturing, and high-quality talent development. R&D priorities include environmentally friendly materials, intelligent manufacturing technologies, digital printing, and innovative packaging designs. Key projects involve micro-engraving for surface effects, flexible cushioning packaging, lightweight recyclable gift boxes, high barrier degradable paper packaging, and pulp molding for sustainable packaging alternatives.
categories.revenue_model: Zhongrong generates revenue primarily through direct sales of printed paper packaging products including folding cartons, gift boxes, and related packaging materials. The company operates on a direct sales model serving both domestic and international customers, with revenue recognized at the point of product delivery and acceptance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as one of the leading enterprises in China's paper-based printing and packaging industry, ranked 11th among China’s top 100 printing and packaging companies. It competes with numerous small and medium-sized enterprises in a fragmented industry with low entry barriers. Zhongrong differentiates itself through advanced technology, intelligent manufacturing, strong brand partnerships, and comprehensive service capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Zhongrong reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.78 billion, representing a 7.3% increase over 2023. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 143.6 million, a decline of 29.6% compared to the previous year. The company’s total assets reached RMB 4.35 billion, growing 7.7% year-over-year. Despite profit decline, the company maintains steady revenue growth and continues investing in capacity expansion and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Zhongrong emphasizes innovation-led intelligent manufacturing and green sustainable packaging solutions to deliver differentiated value. It offers integrated packaging solutions combining creative design, advanced materials, and smart production technologies tailored to customer needs. The company’s commitment to environmental sustainability, digital transformation, and high-quality service strengthens its competitive advantage and long-term partnership with leading brands.
